title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is studying the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli stacks M_{g,ν}. He stratifies the Deligne–Mumford compactification by stable ('MD') graphs and attaches fundamental groupoids to the strata and to their germs. Notation: Π M_G is the fundamental groupoid of the open stratum of type G. For a generalization G → G' (contraction of a set Γ^!_{G,G'} of edges, i.e. smoothing those nodes), M_{G,G'} is the germ of the stratum M_{G'} along M_G. Π M_{G,G'} ≅ Π(M_G, Γ^!_{G,G'}) is the fundamental groupoid of this punctured tubular germ. It is an extension of Π M_G by the Z^{Γ^!_{G,G'}}-torsor of local monodromies (Dehn twists around the vanishing cycles). r_{G,G'} : Π M_{G,G'} → Π M_{G'} is the 'restriction to the generic stratum' functor, and φ_{G,G'} : Π M_{G,G'} → Π M_G is the projection.

On the previous page he formed, for a chain G → G' → G'', a 2-fibre product Π M^*_{G,G',G''}. He observed it is a torsor over Π M^*_{G,G'} under Z^{Γ'}, and also an extension of Π M_G by Z^{Γ ⊔ Γ'}. He then extracted diagram (107).

On this page he wants to complete (107) to a diagram for the second step G' → G''. Diagram (108) is the correspondence Π M_G ← Π M_{G,G''} → Π M_{G''}. The point of the page is a canonical comparison functor (109), Π M_{G,G'} → Π M_{G,G''}. Two equivalent descriptions are given:
- it comes from a canonical morphism of germs of multiplicities M_{G,G'} → M_{G,G''};
- it comes from the inclusion of edge sets (110), Γ^!_{G,G'} ⊂ Γ^!_{G,G''} (the nodes smoothed in G' are among those smoothed in G'').
The inclusion gives the 'can' map (111) of extensions Π(M_G, Γ^!_{G,G'}) → Π(M_G, Γ^!_{G,G''}), compatible with the identifications with Π M_{G,G'} and Π M_{G,G''}. Concretely, the Dehn-twist lattice Z^{Γ'} sits inside Z^{Γ''} over the same Π M_G.

The page ends: 'Ceci posé, on aura un diagramme, je dis qu'il est commutatif.' On the next page this becomes a cube/square claimed 2-cartesian. It identifies the formally defined Π M^*_{G,G',G''} with a concrete pullback extension. The whole page is struck through with two large diagonal lines, so this is a discarded draft of the transitivity ('itération') of the gluing data among strata, i.e. the Teichmüller-tower/'Lego' combinatorics.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The whole page is crossed out, suggesting Grothendieck found the setup or notation unsatisfactory and redid it.

The direction of (109) needs the convention that M_{G,G''} is a 'larger' germ than M_{G,G'}. The inclusion Γ^!_{G,G'} ⊂ Γ^!_{G,G''} gives a map of monodromy lattices Z^{Γ'} → Z^{Γ''}, consistent with the arrow. A geometric morphism of germs M_{G,G'} → M_{G,G''}, however, only makes sense after passing to punctured tubular neighbourhoods and their homotopy types. This is a heuristic gap rather than an error.

ideas.what: The fundamental groupoid of the germ of a boundary stratum of M̄_{g,ν} is an extension of the stratum's fundamental groupoid by the free abelian group (torsor) generated by the nodes, i.e. Dehn twists.
ideas.modern_name: local fundamental group near a normal crossings stratum / Dehn twist subgroups / tangential base points
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Deligne–Mumford, Grothendieck SGA1 tame ramification); for M_g: Ihara–Nakamura, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura
ideas.where_published: SGA1 XIII (log/tame fundamental groups); Esquisse d'un programme (Teichmüller tower, Dehn twists, 'structure à l'infini')

ideas.what: Transitivity of the comparison functors among germs along a chain of generalizations G→G'→G'', induced by the inclusion of sets of contracted edges, and its 2-cartesian compatibility.
ideas.modern_name: functoriality of boundary strata over the poset/category of stable graphs; Teichmüller tower / Lego gluing compatibility
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse), worked out by Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Bakalov–Kirillov, Nakamura–Schneps
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme only sketches it

deep.surprise_reason: A crossed-out bookkeeping step: compatibility of the canonical maps between Dehn-twist extensions along a chain of edge contractions. This is standard and implicit in the Teichmüller tower literature; nothing new.
transcription_corrections: The previous page uses C, C', C''; on this page the letters are likewise C, C', C'' (or G handwritten similarly). The machine transcription switches to G.
The arrow label in (108) is r_{C'',C} (the restriction functor r as on the previous page), not γ.
The insertion above the crossed-out word in line 2 is probably 'généralisation' or 'itération', not 'ritérisation'.
'Par ce cas, notre groupe un morphisme' is better read as 'Pour ceci, notons qu'on a un morphisme canonique'.
The marginal insertion read as 'diverses' may be 'déduit'; the struck-through word near 'multiplicités' is replaced by 'morphisme'.
The whole page is struck through by two large diagonal crosses, which the transcription does not mention.
